search_intent.h1: Water Filtration and Softener Planning in Georgetown
search_intent.description: Compare whole-home water filtration, softening and under-sink reverse osmosis in Georgetown using actual water tests. Confirm connections and provider scope.
search_intent.intro: For water filtration in Georgetown, first distinguish whole-home treatment from a filter serving one drinking-water tap. Use tests of the property's actual municipal or well supply and household demand to compare a softener, staged well treatment or under-sink reverse osmosis. Record hardness, iron, sulphur, sediment or taste concerns as observations, not a diagnosis. Ask which measured concern each stage addresses and what maintenance it needs. If a new tap is proposed, use the fixture installation guide to record cabinet access and connections. Provider scope and availability require confirmation.
